title_en: Call for Participation: 2026 Association of Universities of Asia (AUA) Academic Conference
summary: Faculty members, students, researchers and others who wish to take part in the 2026 AUA Academic Conference on "Artificial Intelligence & Digital Innovation – Solidarity AI" must submit a paper abstract themselves. The deadline is Wednesday, 30 September 2026. The conference is hosted by Chulalongkorn University, Thailand, from 12 to 15 November 2026; the notice does not state where or how to submit the abstract beyond the call title.
applies_to: Faculty members, students, researchers and others (as stated: "faculty and students, researchers, etc.") who wish to apply. Participation is voluntary, not mandatory.

dates.what: Deadline for applicants to submit their paper abstract
Conference period (hosted by Chulalongkorn University, Thailand)

conditions: Applicants must submit their paper abstract directly themselves; the department does not submit on their behalf.
The call is titled "Solidarity AI: Call for Practitioners and Researchers (AUA Members)", indicating it is for members of AUA member institutions.
steps: Review the two attachments to the original notice (the conference poster image and the tentative programme spreadsheet); their content was not read for this translation.
Prepare a paper abstract in response to "Solidarity AI: Call for Practitioners and Researchers (AUA Members)".
Submit the abstract directly yourself by Wednesday, 30 September 2026; the notice does not state the submission method or address.
For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Notice on Participation in the 2026 Association of Universities of Asia (AUA) Academic Conference

1. Programme: 2026 Association of Universities of Asia (AUA) Academic Conference on "Artificial Intelligence & Digital Innovation – Solidarity AI"

2. Period: Thursday, 12 November 2026 to Sunday, 15 November 2026

3. Host: Chulalongkorn University, Thailand

4. Eligibility: Faculty members, students, researchers, etc.

5. Application method
   a. Documents to submit: Paper abstract, submitted directly by the applicant (Solidarity AI: Call for Practitioners and Researchers (AUA Members))
   b. Submission deadline: Wednesday, 30 September 2026

6. Inquiries: Contact the department office (contact details are given in the original notice).

Attachments (2):
- 2026 AUA Academic Conference on Artificial Intelligence & Digital Innovation – Solidarity AI AI.jpeg (3 MB)
- Tentative Program.xlsx (18 KB)

(The content of these attachments was not read for this translation.)
